skills.name: saveit
skills.description: Read and write the user's SaveIt.now bookmarks from the terminal or from JS/TS code, via the official `saveitnow` npm package (CLI + SDK). Handles its own install and API-key setup on first use. Use whenever the user mentions SaveIt, saveit.now, "my bookmarks", "my saved links", "my reading list", asks to save/bookmark a URL, to search what they saved, or to pick something to read.
